q: Again he wedded Wo-nabe-no-iratsume, younger sister of Yakaha-ye-hime

q: Again, he wedded Naga-hime of Idzumi in Himuka

q: Then His Augustness Oho-yama-mori said: "The elder child is the dearer."

q: Next His Augustness Oho-sazaki, knowing the august feeling which made the Heavenly Sovereign deign to ask [the question]

q: His Augustness Oho-yama-mori to administer the government of the mountains and the sea

q: His Augustness Oho-sazaki to take and deign to report on the government of the realm

q: the Heavenly Sovereign forthwith granted Princess Kami-naga to his august child.

q: had the design to slay the Prince his younger brother, secretly raised an army, and prepared to attack him.

q: Meanwhile Uji-no-waki-iratsuko died early. So His Augustness Oho-sazaki did rule the Empire.

q: Forthwith staying in that country, he wedded Saki-tsu-mi, daughter of Tajima-no-matawo

q: So the things which Ama-no-hi-boko brought over here, and which were called the "precious treasures," were: two strings of pearls: likewise a wave-shaking scarf, a wave-cutting scarf, a wind-shaking scarf, and a wind-cutting scarf; likewise a mirror of the offing and a mirror of the shore,—eight articles in all.

s: the eight precious treasures of Ama-no-hi-boko is a eight articles (precious treasures)

q: His Augustness Kamu-nuna-kaha-mimi ruled the Empire.

q: his arms and legs trembled so, that he was unable to slay him. So then the younger brother His Augustness Kamu-nuna-kaha-mimi begged [to be allowed] to take the weapon which his elder brother held, and went in and slew Tagishi-mimi

q: Then His Augustness the Great-High-Integrating-Deity again commanded and taught, saying: "August son of the Heavenly Deity! make no progress hence into the interior.

q: Therefore when fighting with the Prince of Tomi, His Augustness Itsu-se was pierced in his august hand by the Prince of Tomi's hurtful arrow.

s: Takakurazhi is a person of Kumanu
q: At this time Takakurazhi (this is the name of a person) of Kumanu came bearing one cross-sword to the place where the august-child of the Deity was lying prostrate

s: Takakurazhi possesses the cross-sword (in his store-house)
q: So, on my searching my store-house early next morning in accordance with the instructions of the dream, there really was a cross-sword there. So I just present this cross-sword to thee.

s: Ukashi the Elder Brother is a resident of Uda
q: So then there were in Uda two persons, Ukashi the Elder Brother and Ukashi the Younger Brother.

s: Ukashi the Elder Brother dies in the gin (which he himself had set)
q: they drove him in, whereupon he was caught in the gin which he himself had set, and died. So they forthwith pulled him out, and cut him in pieces.

q: But being unable to collect an army he said deceitfully that he would respectfully serve [His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko], and built a great palace, and in that palace set a pitfall, and waited.

q: So then there were in Uda two persons, Ukashi the Elder Brother and Ukashi the Younger Brother.

s: Ukashi the Younger Brother is ancestor of the Water Directors of Uda
q: So Ukashi the Younger Brother (he is the ancestor of the Water Directors of Uda).

q: The two Deities His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko and his elder brother His Augustness Itsu-se, dwelling in the palace of Takachiho. took counsel, saying:

The savage Deities are very numerous. I will now send from Heaven a crow eight feet [long]. So that crow eight feet [long] shall guide thee.

s: Great-High-Integrating-Deity sends the eight-foot crow (from Heaven)
q: I will now send from Heaven a crow eight feet [long]. So that crow eight feet [long] shall guide thee.

s: the august army is bewildered prostrate (had fallen)

s: the august army is temporarily exhausted exhausted (during the battle with Shiki the Elder Brother and Shiki the Younger Brother)
q: Again when he smote Shiki the Elder Brother and Shiki the Younger Brother, the august army was temporarily exhausted.

s: Himuka is left by they (on their progress to Tsukushi)
q: Forthwith they left Himuka on their progress to Tsukushi.

s: Kumanu is a village

s: Uda contains Ukashi the Elder Brother (with Ukashi the Younger Brother)

s: Tomi is associated with Nagasune-biko
q: At this time Nagasune-biko of Tomi raised an army

s: Mount Unebi is near the palace of Kashibara
q: [His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko] dwelt at the palace of Kashibara near Unebi and ruled the Empire.

q: [His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko] dwelt at the palace of Kashibara near Unebi and ruled the Empire.

s: the eastward progress is a progress (from Himuka toward the east)

s: Itsu-se's death occurs at river-mouth of Wo (after being struck by the enemy's hand)
q: Making a progress round from thence, and arriving at the river-mouth of Wo in the land of Ki, he said: "Ah! that I should die stricken by the wretched villain's hand!" and expired as a valiant man.

s: the conquest and pacification of the Empire is completed by His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko
q: So having thus subdued and pacified the savage Deities, and extirpated the unsubmissive people, [His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko] dwelt at the palace of Kashibara near Unebi and ruled the Empire.

s: His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko dwells at Kashibara (near Unebi)
q: So having thus subdued and pacified the savage Deities, and extirpated the unsubmissive people, [His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko] dwelt at the palace of Kashibara near Unebi and ruled the Empire.

s: the slaying of Ukashi the Elder Brother is caused by the pitfall

q: So then the younger brother His Augustness Kamu-nuna-kaha-mimi begged [to be allowed] to take the weapon which his elder brother held, and went in and slew Tagishi-mimi.

s: the cross-sword dwells in the temple of the Deity of Isonokami
q: This sword dwells in the temple of the Deity of Isonokami

q: So on [His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko] making his progress following after the crow eight feet [long] in obedience to the Deity's instructions

q: The Mausoleum, too, is on Mount Kama in the land of Ki.

s: the imperial mausoleum is also located at Kashi Spur (on the northern side of Mount Unebi)
q: His august mausoleum is on the top of the Kashi Spur on the northern side of Mount Unebi.

s: His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko has age one hundred and thirty-seven (august years)
q: Altogether the august years of this Heavenly Sovereign Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko were one hundred and thirty-seven.

s: His Augustness Itsu-se is a elder brother of His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko
q: The two Deities His Augustness Kamu-yamato-ihare-biko and his elder brother His Augustness Itsu-se, dwelling in the palace of Takachiho. took counsel, saying:

s: His Augustness Itsu-se has mausoleum at Mount Kama (in the land of Ki)

q: This Heavenly Sovereign wedded Kaha-mata-bime

q: and begot an august child: His Augustness Shiki-tsu-hiko-tama-demi (one Deity)

s: His Augustness Kamu-nuna-kaha-mimi had august years forty-five
q: The Heavenly Sovereign's august years were forty-five.

s: His Augustness Kamu-nuna-kaha-mimi had mausoleum the august mausoleum
q: His august mausoleum is on the Mound of Tsukida.

s: Kaha-mata-bime is ancestress of the Departmental Lords of Shiki
q: Kaha-mata-bime, ancestress of the Departmental Lords of Shiki

s: Shiki-tsu-hiko-tama-demi is a Deity (one)

s: His Augustness Wa-chi-tsumi has child Hahe-irodo (younger daughter)

s: His Augustness Shiki-tsu-hiko-tama-de-mi rules the Empire
q: His Augustness Shiki-tsu-hiko-tama-de-mi dwelt in the palace of Ukiana at Kata-shiha, and ruled the Empire.

s: His Augustness Shiki-tsu-hiko-tama-de-mi has age forty-nine years (august years)
q: The Heavenly Sovereign's august years were forty-nine.

s: His Augustness Shiki-tsu-hiko-tama-de-mi weds Akuto-hime
q: This Heavenly Sovereign wedded Akuto-hime, daughter of the Departmental Lord Haye, elder brother of Kaha-mata-bime, and begot august children:

s: Akuto-hime is a daughter (of the Departmental Lord Haye)
q: This Heavenly Sovereign wedded Akuto-hime, daughter of the Departmental Lord Haye, elder brother of Kaha-mata-bime, and begot august children:

s: Akuto-hime is daughter of Departmental Lord Haye (elder brother of Kaha-mata-bime)
